name: Aikagi 3
source:
"She is here again, huh...?"

Sighing, our protagonist, Yuuto, put the key to his house that he just took out back into his pocket without using it. Upon entering, he found his childhood friend, Saotome Ai, fiddling with her phone, relaxing as if it were her own house. The spare key (AIKAGI) to the house was hanging from her neck. 

"Ah, welcome back, senpai~."

A girl one year younger than him welcomed him home with a smile, (though she was lazing about while doing so.) 

"I'm back... Hey, how many times have I told you not to come in as you please? Also, give me back my spare key already..."

Revolving around the AIKAGI, this is how the love story between our amiable but easy-to-tease protagonist, and his mischievous junior begins.

[From [url=http://azarashi-soft.nexton-net.jp/aikagi3/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
“她又来了啊……？”

主人公雄斗叹了口气，没有使用，就把刚拿出来的家门钥匙放回了口袋里。一进门，他就发现青梅竹马的早乙女爱正在摆弄手机，就像在自己家里一样放松。脖子上挂着房子的备用钥匙（AIKAGI）。

“啊，欢迎回来，学长～”

一个比他小一岁的女孩微笑着欢迎他回家（尽管她在做这件事时正在偷懒。） 

“我回来了……哎，跟你说过多少次了，别随意进来啊？还有，把我的备用钥匙还给我……”

围绕着AIKAGI，可爱又容易捉弄的主人公和调皮的后辈之间的爱情故事就这样开始了。

[来自[url=http://azarashi-soft.nexton-net.jp/aikagi3/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
